name: Stability-Ball Hamstring Curl

instructions.description: Lie on the back with heels on a stability ball.
Lift the hips to a comfortable bridge position.
Bend the knees to roll the ball toward the body.
Extend the legs slowly while keeping the hips controlled.

variations.variationDescription: Stability-Ball Hamstring Curl — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Stability-Ball Hamstring Curl — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Use a clear floor area and slow the movement.
